title: Subscribers.
bodyText: Any person may make application for, enter into agreement for and hold policies or contracts in or with, and be a subscriber of a domestic, foreign or alien reciprocal insurer.
bodyHtml: §431:4-414  Subscribers.  Any person may make application for, enter into agreement for and hold policies or contracts in or with, and be a subscriber of a domestic, foreign or alien reciprocal insurer. [L 1987, c 347, pt of §2]
